description: Get quality metrics for any tool — uptime percentage, p50/p95 latency, error rate, total calls in last 24h. Check reliability before calling expensive tools. Updated every 10 minutes. Free, no charge (APIbase)

tool_id.description: Tool ID to get quality metrics for (e.g. "crypto.get_price", "weather.get_current")

name: platform.quality.tool

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Tool Quality Metrics
